title: merge_preview
summary: Simulate a 3-way merge of the authorized group worktree's HEAD onto target_ref without making any change, and report conflicted files, whether the merge is clean, and the resulting tree oid (merge_tree).
purpose: Simulate a 3-way merge of the authorized group worktree's HEAD onto target_ref without making any change, and report conflicted files, whether the merge is clean, and the resulting tree oid (merge_tree).

fields.name: target_ref
fields.description: Target ref; option-shaped values and revspecs are forbidden. Omitted: the token group's work base (the project base without a group) start point — origin/<branch> when origin is ahead, else <branch>.

details: Replace {name} in the route with path_parameters.name.
Do not edit the project source on disk directly — every source read and change goes through these tools.

Uses only git merge-tree --write-tree and never changes HEAD, the index, or the working tree (it may leave merged tree/blob objects in the object database internally, but none are reachable from any ref).
conflicts is populated only when clean=false; if it exceeds 200 (_MAX_CONFLICT_FILES) it is truncated and truncated=true.
This is a preview, not an actual merge -- actually merging requires human intervention or a different procedure, not this tool.

merge_tree is the candidate merge result tree oid. Regardless of whether the merge is clean, pass it directly as the ref to read/grep/glob to inspect that tree's merge result; conflicted files include <<<<<<< / ======= / >>>>>>> markers.

See a conflicted path from five angles at once -- current worktree: read(path) (ref omitted, includes uncommitted changes) / worker branch's committed HEAD: read(path, ref=head) / target/main: read(path, ref=target_sha) / common base: read(path, ref=merge_base) / candidate merge result: read(path, ref=merge_tree). Pass this response's head/target_sha/merge_base/merge_tree straight through as ref, and the same ref works for grep/glob/stat too.

errors.when: The ref is missing or the merge-base/rev-parse/merge-tree git command failed.
target_ref has an invalid form, or the request carries a field merge_preview does not allow (reason=unknown_field).
This token does not have the read scope.
